headline: Every pack of pies checked, not a sample.
label: #FFFFFF
heroLede: With several brands going into similar cartons, the label is what tells one pie from the next. Here's what a camera check could look like at the end of your packing line. Scroll through, then adjust the estimate at the end to your own numbers.
lidLede: The camera checks every carton is closed and glued, flaps down and square. An open carton in a freezer means damaged pies and a complaint from the store.
labelLede: A beef pack and a beef and cheese pack look much the same at line speed, and one of them carries milk. The camera checks every carton carries the right label for the pies inside, straight and intact.
codeLede: The best-before and batch code has to be right and readable on every carton. The system reads the printed code and compares it with the product and date set at changeover.
objectLede: Pastry offcuts, glove pieces and loose parts can end up close to the line. The camera over the belt spots anything that should not be there before it reaches a case.

vocab.alert: Four open flaps in fifteen minutes. Check the cartoner.
